VB-CABLE Virtual Audio Device is a product of VB-Audio Software.
Origin: www.vb-cable.com

VB-CABLE is a donationware, all participations are welcome.

Release builds of AVcompanion place VB-Audio's driver pack in this folder,
unmodified, so the app can offer it as an optional add-on. The pack itself is
not stored in this source repository: the build downloads it from VB-Audio and
checks it against the SHA-256 recorded in ../vbcable.sha256.

AVcompanion never installs it silently. You press "Install VB-CABLE", Windows
asks for administrator approval, and VB-Audio's own setup window opens.
